name: Manappuram Finance Ltd
title: Manappuram Finance Ltd - 531213 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gold loan AUM up 12% QoQ to INR54,655 cr standalone with yield up 59 bps to ~18%; management guides FY27 gold growth 25-30% and 500 new branches, but no supply-side capacity data, and microfinance and vehicle books shrinking.

triggers.label: Gold loan yield up 59 bps QoQ
triggers.quote: our gold loan yield has improved by 59 basis points during the quarter
triggers.highlight: gold loan yield has improved by 59 basis points

triggers.label: FY27 gold loan growth 25-30%
triggers.quote: We expect that to be some between 25%-30%

triggers.label: ~500 new branches planned FY27
triggers.quote: we have the plan to open around 500 branches now

triggers.label: Competitive intensity rising in gold loans
triggers.quote: we are seeing a lot of competition on the ground in gold loans
triggers.highlight: a lot of competition on the ground

guidance.quote: We expect that to be some between 25%-30%

red_flags.label: Vehicle finance GNPA rising, book down 43% YoY
red_flags.quote: GNPA continues to be elevated at 13.3% versus 10.4% in prior quarter

red_flags.label: Gold price-driven LTV shift and stretched IGA LTV up to 85%
red_flags.quote: For income generating assets, we go up to 85%, this is the maximum, 85%.

evasions.quote: That can be shared separately. We have to take that separate.
It may go down by 25 basis points or go up by 25 basis.

summary.headline: Manappuram Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT rose 45% QoQ to INR585 crore, with consolidated AUM up 9% QoQ to INR69,635 crore.
